design_identity.name: The Philatelic Curator
design_identity.core_philosophy: Digital Tactility: The user should feel like they are handling rare paper artifacts.

headings.usage: All section titles, hero text, and product names. Use strict tracking-tight.

data_mono.usage: Price, Rarity Score, Date, Serial Numbers.

usage_rules: Backgrounds must be warm off-white (Paper), NOT sterile #FFFFFF.
Brand Primary (Burgundy) is for CTAs and 'Add to Cart' buttons only.
Use Brand Secondary (Royal Blue) for Trust indicators and Info.
Gold Accent is for 'Rare' or 'Mint Condition' tags only.

effects.perforation_mask: radial-gradient(circle, transparent 3px, black 3.5px) left top/10px 10px space

StampCard.description: A card that looks like a mounted stamp in a collector's album.
specs: White padding (p-6) around the image to simulate a mount.
Optional CSS mask for perforated edges on the image itself.
Typography: Serif for title, Mono for price.
Hover: Subtle lift (-4px) + 'Loupe' icon fade in.

HeroSection.content: Left: Large serif typography + CTA. Right: Floating 3D-style stamp composition.
HeroSection.background: Subtle topographical map or postmark pattern opacity 0.05.

AIUploadWidget.animation: Scanning beam (linear gradient) moving top to bottom over the image.

magnifying_glass.usage: About Us or Inspection Feature Promo

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a custom 'Perforation' border using CSS mask or SVG for the stamp cards.
The AI Analysis page should feel like a 'Lab' - clean, white, mono fonts for data.
The Shop page should feel like a 'Gallery' - warm background, elegant serif fonts.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Use the specific HEX codes provided in colors.palette for the Tailwind config.
Do NOT use standard pure black (#000000). Use the Ink Blue (#2c3e50 equivalent) defined.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
